consilience_assessment_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the assessment, generated by the database.

analysis_run_id.description: Analysis that produced the assessment, and through which the specification that defined the rules can be recovered.

match_group_id.description: Match group assessed, when the assessment targets a group. Exactly one of the group and the event references is populated, which a constraint enforces, so an assessment always has one unambiguous subject.

consensus_event_id.description: Consensus event assessed, when the assessment targets a derived event instead. The alternative to the group reference, never populated alongside it.

status.description: The automated conclusion, such as a correspondence supported by feature evidence, one supported only temporally, one whose features disagreed, one whose topology was ambiguous, or a detection no other extractor corroborated. The last of those means only that no eligible cross-extractor correspondence survived this specification; it is not a claim that the detection was false. A manual verdict never overwrites this column, so it always reports what the algorithm decided.

score.description: Numeric score for the assessment. Left null by the current implementation, deliberately: the status is a categorical evidence summary under one rule set, and no calibration exists that would justify reading a number here as a probability that an event occurred.

rationale_json.description: The evidence behind the status, preserved as JSON text: the rule set and its version and checksum, the topology, the rule text that produced the status, which feature comparisons were available, within tolerance, outside it, or not computable, and the temporal evidence read from the candidate. What makes the status auditable rather than merely asserted.

assessed_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp recorded when the assessment was written. An audit time.

manual_reviews.description: A human verdict on something VAWLUME already holds: a detection, a match group, or a consensus event. Independent evidence, never derived from extractor state, and it never overwrites an automated status; where the two disagree, both remain readable and the resolution is computed rather than stored.

manual_review_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the review, generated by the database.

analysis_run_id.description: Analysis the review was made in the context of. Null for a review not tied to one, and set to null rather than removed if that analysis is deleted, because the human judgement outlives the run that prompted it.

detection_id.description: Detection reviewed, when the review targets one. Exactly one of the three subject references is populated, which a constraint enforces.

match_group_id.description: Match group reviewed, when the review targets a correspondence rather than a single detection.

consensus_event_id.description: Consensus event reviewed, when the review targets a derived interval.

reviewer_label.description: Identifier for the person or protocol that made the verdict. Recorded so reviews can be attributed and compared, not to establish authority.

review_status.description: The human verdict, from a sub-vocabulary separate from the automated statuses. Adjudication values belong here and never appear in the automated status column, which is what keeps the algorithm's conclusion and the reviewer's distinguishable.

corrected_start_time_s.description: Onset the reviewer considers correct, in seconds from the recording's start. Recorded as the reviewer's assertion alongside the original; no native or derived timing is rewritten by it.

corrected_end_time_s.description: Offset the reviewer considers correct, never before the corrected onset. Like the onset, an assertion held beside the original rather than replacing it.

reviewed_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp recorded when the review was written. An audit time.

notes.description: Free-text remarks from the reviewer. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

manual_reference_events.description: An event a reviewer marked in a recording, belonging to a named reference set rather than to any analysis. Scoped this way on purpose: a reference set anchors every configuration compared against it, and it can hold an event no extractor found, which is what makes recall and false negatives representable at all.

manual_reference_event_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the reference event, generated by the database.

recording_id.description: Recording the reviewer marked the event in. Reference events are scoped to a recording and a set, never to an analysis run, so one reviewed subset can anchor comparisons across many configurations.

reference_set_key.description: Name of the reviewed subset this event belongs to. Whether the set covers a whole recording or only part of it is declared in the specification that consumes it, because that is a property of how the review was conducted rather than something the schema can know.

native_reference_id.description: The reviewer's own identifier for the event, preserved as expressed. Together with the recording and the set it forms the event's durable identity.

reviewer_label.description: Identifier for the person or protocol that marked the event.

start_time_s.description: Onset the reviewer marked, in seconds from the recording's start.

end_time_s.description: Offset the reviewer marked, never before the onset.

event_status.description: Whether the reviewer marked the event plainly or flagged it as uncertain. The uncertainty is the reviewer's own and is preserved rather than resolved, so a comparison can choose whether to count it.

reviewed_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp recorded when the reference event was written. An audit time, not when the reviewer looked at the audio.

notes.description: Free-text remarks from the reviewer about this event. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

agreement_statistics.description: An aggregate summarizing how far two extraction runs agreed, under one analysis. Belongs to the pairwise consilience layer despite its general name: the arbitrary-N agreement layer stores no summary at all, because its counts and patterns are computed from member and edge rows so they cannot drift from the evidence. Only aggregates live here; the per-comparison values behind them are recomputable and deliberately not cached.

agreement_statistic_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the aggregate, generated by the database.

analysis_run_id.description: Analysis this aggregate belongs to, ordinarily a child run whose parent is the matching analysis being summarized and which cites the same specification and ordered inputs, so the aggregate is self-describing.

statistic_kind.description: Which family the aggregate belongs to, from a declared vocabulary separating agreement about which events were detected, agreement about measured feature values, diagnostics about the matching itself, and anything else. The family determines which of the optional references below are meaningful.

feature_a_id.description: One of the two registered extractor features a feature-level aggregate concerns. Populated together with the other endpoint so the aggregate stays traceable to the exact registered pair it summarizes; null for an aggregate that is not about a feature pair. Unlike the endpoints of a candidate pair, these carry no enforced ordering.

feature_b_id.description: The other registered extractor feature of the pair a feature-level aggregate concerns. Null for an aggregate that is not about a feature pair.

scope_entity_id.description: Experimental entity the aggregate was computed within, when it was scoped more narrowly than the whole analysis. Null for an aggregate over everything the analysis covered.

statistic_name.description: What quantity this row reports, within its family. The name identifies the measure; its denominator, direction, and exact definition travel with the row rather than being inferred from the name.

statistic_value.description: The value of the reported quantity. On the scale its own definition establishes and uncalibrated, so it describes what two runs did under one specification rather than how well either performed.

lower_bound.description: Lower end of an interval around the value, where the measure defines one. Null where it does not, and not to be read as a confidence interval unless the row's own definition says so.

upper_bound.description: Upper end of an interval around the value, where the measure defines one.

n_observations.description: How many observations the aggregate was computed over. The denominator a value must be read against: a high agreement rate over three events and over three hundred are different claims.

notes.description: Structured detail carrying the aggregate's denominator, direction, scope, and definition. Preserved as text because those facts must travel with the number rather than being reconstructed from its name.

agreement_groups.description: A component of detections that an arbitrary-N agreement run composed for one recording from the exact candidate edges of two or more pairwise analyses. Pairwise correspondence remains the primitive; this layer composes those results without replacing them, and may only hang off a run declaring the agreement type.

agreement_group_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the component, generated by the database.

analysis_run_id.description: Agreement run that composed this component. A trigger refuses a group whose run is not of the arbitrary-N agreement type, so composed results cannot be grafted onto a pairwise matching analysis.

recording_id.description: Recording the component's detections belong to. Composition is per recording, and the recording must belong to the run's project.

group_key.description: Stable identity of the component, built from the sorted list of its members' selectors, and unique within its run. This rather than the surrogate key is what makes two runs' components comparable.

derivation_method.description: How the component was composed from the source analyses' edges. Recorded because the composition rule is a choice, and a component means something different under a different one.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the component. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

agreement_group_members.description: Records that one detection belongs to one composed agreement component. A detection belongs to exactly one component of a given agreement run, and may belong to a component in as many agreement runs as have considered it.

detection_id.description: Detection that belongs to it, which must come from the run's declared extraction inputs and must not already belong to another component of the same run. The detection cannot be deleted while the component holds it: a member joined to the component by no candidate edge would otherwise vanish silently, leaving a component whose stored key still named it.

member_role.description: How this detection sits within the component, where the members need distinguishing.

agreement_supporting_edges.description: Records that one pairwise candidate edge is part of what holds a composed component together. Citing the exact edge rather than a count is the point: the evidence for a composed component stays inspectable, and summary quantities are computed from these rows instead of being stored beside them.

agreement_supporting_edge_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the citation, generated by the database.

candidate_pair_id.description: Exact pairwise candidate edge being cited, which must come from one of the run's declared source analyses, describe the same recording, and join two detections that are both members of this component. The cited candidate cannot be deleted while the citation stands. Whether a citation is recorded never depends on feature support or consilience status: an edge is cited for joining two members, and what the features said is a separate question.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about this citation. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

timebases.description: One declared clock coordinate system, such as a recording sample clock, video frame clock, controller clock, or acquisition-system clock. Being an alignment reference is a property of an alignment set, not of this row.

timebase_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the declared clock, generated by the database.

project_id.description: Project in which this clock is declared.

recording_id.description: Recording this clock belongs to, when it is recording-scoped. Null for a project-scoped clock that may be shared by several streams.

timebase_name.description: Caller-supplied name for the clock, unique within its recording when recording-scoped and otherwise within its project.

timebase_kind.description: Free-text description of the kind of clock. VAWLUME deliberately imposes no acquisition-device vocabulary on this field.

is_recording_native.description: Whether this is the single clock in which the recording's detections are expressed (1) or not (0). A native recording clock must name a recording.

native_unit.description: Unit in which values on this clock are expressed, as declared for the timebase.

nominal_rate_hz.description: Declared nominal sampling or frame rate in hertz. Null when no rate was supplied; absence is not a claim of zero rate.

origin_description.description: Free-text account of what native time zero means for this clock. Null when the origin was not described.

clock_identifier.description: Source- or device-facing identifier for the clock, when one was supplied. Null when the source exposes no separate identifier.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the declared clock. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

external_streams.description: One logical stream of external records on a declared clock, such as the behaviour scoring for a session. Files supplying the stream are recorded separately so one stream may span or survive several exports.

external_stream_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the logical stream, generated by the database.

project_id.description: Project that owns this logical stream.

recording_id.description: Recording this stream accompanies, when it is recording-scoped. Null for a project-scoped stream.

timebase_id.description: Clock in whose native coordinates this stream's events and coverage intervals are stated.

stream_name.description: Caller-supplied name for the logical stream, unique within its recording when recording-scoped and otherwise within its project.

stream_kind.description: Operational category separating event, continuous, annotation, video, TTL, tracking, and other streams without treating modality as clock identity.

modality.description: Free-text modality label supplied for the stream. Null when no modality was declared.

units.description: Declared units for values carried by the stream, when one stream-level unit applies. Null when units are absent or belong on individual events or attributes.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the logical stream. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

external_stream_sources.description: Records one provenance source that supplied records for a logical external stream. Each row names exactly one registered source file or artifact, and several rows may compose one stream.

external_stream_source_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for this stream-source citation, generated by the database.

external_stream_id.description: Logical external stream whose records came from the cited source.

source_file_id.description: Registered source file that supplied the records. Null when the row cites an artifact instead; exactly one of the two source references is present.

artifact_id.description: Registered artifact that supplied the records. Null when the row cites a source file instead; exactly one of the two source references is present.

source_role.description: Role the cited source plays for the stream, distinguishing event, anchor, coverage, attribute, and other records.

mapping_profile_version_id.description: Configuration-profile version used to interpret this source, when one was registered. Null means no mapping-profile version is cited.

source_locator.description: Location within the cited file or artifact from which these stream records came, when the source exposes one.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about this provenance citation. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

external_events.description: One event observed in a logical external stream, retaining the source's native identity, label, and timestamps beside an operational event key. Native time is evidence and is never rewritten during alignment.

external_event_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the external event, generated by the database.

external_stream_id.description: Logical stream in which this event was observed and whose timebase gives its native clock.

entity_id.description: Experimental entity the source declared this event concerned, when that label resolved to an existing entity. Null means no declared link resolved; this lookup is not visual-identity evidence.

native_event_id.description: Identifier supplied by the source for this event, unique within the stream when present. Null when the source supplied none; VAWLUME does not invent one.

native_event_label.description: Event label preserved from the source's own vocabulary. Null when the source supplied no native label.

event_type.description: Normalized operational key VAWLUME queries for this event. It may repeat the native label when no mapping rule supplies a different key and is not a universal behavioural or neural taxonomy.

start_time_native.description: Event start in the external stream's native clock. Alignment never updates this value; projected time is derived from a stored transform.

end_time_native.description: Event end in the external stream's native clock. Null for a point event; when present it cannot precede the native start and is never overwritten by alignment.

value_text.description: Text-valued scalar carried by the event, when the mapped event has one. Null when absent or when its scalar value is numeric.

value_real.description: Numeric scalar carried by the event, when the mapped event has one. Null when absent or when its scalar value is text.

unit.description: Declared unit for the event's scalar value, when one was supplied. Null means the value has no recorded unit, not that it is dimensionless.

mapping_rule_key.description: Key of the mapping rule that produced the operational event representation, when the profile records one.

source_locator.description: Location of this event within its source, such as a row or record locator, when one was retained.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the external event. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

external_event_attributes.description: One named long-form attribute mapped from an external event. The row preserves the native field and token while storing exactly one typed value, or an explicit missing-value statement.

external_event_attribute_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the event attribute, generated by the database.

external_event_id.description: External event this mapped attribute describes.

attribute_name.description: Canonical attribute name assigned by the mapping profile, unique within the event.

native_field_name.description: Field name used by the source before mapping. Null when the source did not expose a distinct field name.

value_type.description: Declared representation of the mapped value, separating text, real, integer, boolean, JSON, and explicit missingness.

value_text.description: Text payload when value_type is text. Null for every other representation and for an explicit missing value.

value_real.description: Real-number payload when value_type is real. Null for every other representation and for an explicit missing value.

value_integer.description: Integer payload when value_type is integer. Null for every other representation and for an explicit missing value.

value_boolean.description: Boolean payload encoded as 1 or 0 when value_type is boolean. Null for every other representation and for an explicit missing value.

value_json.description: JSON text payload when value_type is json. Null for every other representation and for an explicit missing value.

native_raw_token.description: Verbatim source token retained before type conversion, including a source missing-value token when one occurred. Null when no raw token was retained.

unit.description: Declared unit for this attribute value, when supplied by the mapping. Null means no unit was recorded.

source_locator.description: Location of this attribute within the source, when a row, field, or record locator was retained.

mapping_rule_key.description: Key of the mapping rule that interpreted this native field, when the profile records one.

external_stream_coverage.description: One profile-declared interval during which an external stream was observed, stated on that stream's native clock. Outside all such intervals availability is unknown, not evidence that no event occurred.

external_stream_coverage_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the coverage interval, generated by the database.

external_stream_id.description: Logical stream whose observation coverage this interval asserts.

segment_index.description: One-based position of this coverage segment within the stream's declared coverage.

start_time_native.description: Start of the observed interval in the stream's native clock. This source coordinate is never rewritten by alignment.

end_time_native.description: End of the observed interval in the stream's native clock; it cannot precede the native start and is never rewritten by alignment.

observation_status.description: Stream-level assertion about observation during this interval. The current vocabulary records observed intervals only; it does not describe transform support or extrapolation.

source_locator.description: Location in the source or profile from which this coverage assertion came, when one was retained.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the declared coverage interval. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

alignment_sets.description: One user-facing alignment operation that chooses a reference clock and groups the pairwise source-to-reference fits for a session. The reference is a coordinate choice, not a claim that its device is intrinsically correct.

alignment_set_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the alignment set, generated by the database.

analysis_run_id.description: Analysis run whose provenance and durable run identity belong to this alignment operation. Each analysis run can own at most one alignment set.

recording_id.description: Recording whose participating clocks are being aligned, when the set is recording-scoped. Null when no single recording scopes the set.

reference_timebase_id.description: Clock chosen as the coordinate system in which this set expresses other clocks. The choice does not assert that this clock is more accurate.

manifest_source_file_id.description: Registered source file containing the session-specific alignment manifest, when the manifest was file-backed. Null when absent or when an artifact is cited instead.

manifest_artifact_id.description: Registered artifact containing the session-specific alignment manifest, when artifact-backed. Null when absent or when a source file is cited instead.

alignment_set_key.description: Caller-supplied identifier for this alignment operation, when one was supplied. Null while no external key has been declared.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the set, distinguishing assembly, completed fitting, an explicit validation or rejection state, and failure. Current fitting moves a fully estimated set to fitted and never declares it validated.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the alignment operation. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

time_alignment_runs.description: One attempt to express a source clock in its parent alignment set's reference clock. The row records the declared model and fit summaries; segment coefficients remain the transform authority.

alignment_run_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the pairwise transform attempt, generated by the database.

alignment_set_id.description: Alignment set that owns this source-to-reference transform attempt.

source_timebase_id.description: Source clock whose native values the stored transform accepts. It must differ from the target clock.

target_timebase_id.description: Reference clock in which transformed values are expressed. A trigger requires it to equal the parent alignment set's reference, so it is a readable convenience rather than a second authority.

method.description: Declared transform family: fixed-scale offset, affine, or continuous piecewise affine over caller-declared breakpoints. The method is not inferred from residuals.

n_anchors_used.description: Number of logical anchors used by the stored fit. On a registered but unfitted run, the current intake records the number then fit-eligible; null means no count was recorded, not zero.

fit_rmse_s.description: Root-mean-square residual in seconds across included anchors for the estimated fit. Null before or without a fit; the reported value is not an acceptance threshold or verdict.

max_error_s.description: Largest absolute residual in seconds across included anchors for the estimated fit. Null before or without a fit; it is reported evidence, not a pass/fail criterion.

status.description: State of this transform attempt, separating registered, estimated, validated, rejected, and failed. Current fitting records successful solutions as estimated and has no rule that produces validated.

failure_code.description: Machine-readable reason a transform failed, or a reason attached to a rejection. Null for registered or estimated runs and for a rejection with no coded cause.

failure_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of a failed or rejected outcome. It is required whenever failure_code is present; null means no explanation was recorded.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the transform attempt. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

alignment_run_breakpoints.description: One caller-declared source-clock breakpoint belonging to a piecewise-affine transform. VAWLUME persists the declaration for reproducibility and never estimates a breakpoint from residuals.

alignment_run_breakpoint_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the breakpoint declaration, generated by the database.

alignment_run_id.description: Piecewise-affine transform attempt whose source clock this breakpoint partitions.

breakpoint_index.description: One-based order of the breakpoint within the transform's declared set. Application validation, not this column alone, requires the set to increase monotonically.

source_time.description: Breakpoint coordinate on the transform's source clock. It is declared input, not a timestamp estimated by VAWLUME.

declared_by.description: Free-text indication of how the breakpoint declaration arrived, currently supplied by the caller rather than inferred by fitting.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the breakpoint declaration. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

alignment_anchors.description: One logical synchronization occurrence within an alignment set. It identifies what coordinated the clocks but stores no timestamp; separate observations record how each clock witnessed it.

alignment_anchor_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the logical synchronization anchor, generated by the database.

alignment_set_id.description: Alignment set within which this coordinating occurrence has its identity.

anchor_key.description: Caller-supplied identity for the logical anchor, unique within the alignment set and used to pair observations across clocks without nearest-time matching.

anchor_type.description: Free-text description of the kind of synchronization occurrence, such as a pulse or marker, without turning a nearby experimental event into the anchor itself.

expected_order.description: Caller-declared one-based expected position of this anchor in an ordered series, when supplied. Null means no expected order was declared.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the logical anchor. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

alignment_anchor_observations.description: One witnessing of a logical synchronization anchor on one timebase. Replicate readings remain separate QC evidence; at most one observation per anchor and clock may be included in a fit.

anchor_observation_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for this clock reading of an anchor, generated by the database.

alignment_anchor_id.description: Logical synchronization anchor that this observation witnessed.

timebase_id.description: Clock on which observed_time_native was read. This is the observation clock, not necessarily the source or reference role it may take in a particular fit.

external_event_id.description: External event that supplied this marker reading, when one exists. Null for a manually identified timestamp; a trigger requires a cited event to be on the same clock.

observed_time_native.description: Observed anchor time in this observation's own native clock. It is preserved evidence and is never replaced with an aligned value.

observation_role.description: Declared role separating the primary reading, a retained replicate, and an excluded reading. An excluded observation cannot also claim inclusion in the fit.

included_in_fit.description: Whether this reading is selected to influence a fit (1) or retained without influencing it (0). Replicates and withheld observations remain evidence and are not pooled as independent anchors.

evidence_class.description: Whether the reading is device-level and identity-independent or depends on the identity of a biological event. Null means the class was never declared, not that it is device-level.

uncertainty_s.description: Recorded reading uncertainty for this observation, in seconds on its native clock. Null means no uncertainty was recorded, not zero; it is preserved and propagated but never used as a fit weight.

uncertainty_semantics.description: Text stating what the recorded uncertainty value means when one is present. Null when uncertainty_s is absent.

source_file_id.description: Registered source file from which this anchor reading came, when file-backed. Null when no source file is cited.

mapping_profile_version_id.description: Configuration-profile version used to interpret this observation, when one was registered. Null means no mapping-profile version is cited.

source_locator.description: Location of this observation within its source, such as a row or marker locator, when one was retained.

notes.description: Free-text audit log and remarks about this reading, including declared inclusion decisions. Never interpreted as a timestamp or fit result.

alignment_anchor_identity_evidence.description: Records that an identity-dependent anchor observation is qualified by one existing track-to-entity identity association. Several rows may preserve ambiguity, and fitting never consumes their scores.

alignment_anchor_identity_evidence_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the evidence link, generated by the database.

anchor_observation_id.description: Identity-dependent anchor observation being qualified. A trigger refuses the link if the observation does not declare that evidence class.

tracking_identity_association_id.description: Existing native-track to canonical-entity association cited as identity evidence. It cannot be deleted while this qualifying link remains.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about why this identity association qualifies the observation. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

alignment_anchor_residuals.description: One run-specific residual for a logical anchor, naming the exact source-clock and reference-clock observations compared. It is fit evidence left after prediction, not a validation verdict.

alignment_anchor_residual_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the residual row, generated by the database.

alignment_run_id.description: Source-to-reference transform attempt under which this residual was calculated.

alignment_anchor_id.description: Logical anchor whose two clock observations produced this run-specific residual.

source_observation_id.description: Anchor observation on the transform's source clock. A trigger distinguishes this endpoint from the reference observation and holds it within the same run and anchor.

reference_observation_id.description: Anchor observation on the transform's target reference clock. A trigger distinguishes this endpoint from the source observation and holds it within the same run and anchor.

observed_source_time.description: Native source-clock reading copied from the cited source observation when this residual was computed, retained so the calculation can be audited.

observed_reference_time.description: Native reference-clock reading copied from the cited reference observation when this residual was computed, retained so the calculation can be audited.

predicted_reference_time.description: Reference-clock time predicted by applying this run's stored transform to observed_source_time.

residual_s.description: Observed reference time minus predicted reference time, in seconds. The value is reported evidence and is never itself a threshold, pass/fail result, or calibrated quality judgement.

included_in_fit.description: Whether this anchor pair influenced the fitted coefficients (1) or was evaluated without influencing them (0). A withheld anchor can still carry a residual.

exclusion_reason.description: Reason this residual's observations were excluded from the fit. Required when included_in_fit is 0 and otherwise normally absent.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about this run-specific residual. Never parsed by VAWLUME.

alignment_segments.description: One continuous affine segment of a stored source-to-reference transform, applying target_time = scale times source_time plus offset_s. These coefficients, together with native timestamps, are authoritative for projection.

alignment_segment_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the transform segment, generated by the database.

alignment_run_id.description: Source-to-reference transform attempt whose coefficients this segment carries.

segment_index.description: One-based order of the segment within the transform. Application validation requires the complete segment set to tile the source axis without gaps or overlaps.

source_start.description: Inclusive lower bound on the source clock for this segment. Null opens the first segment below all finite source times.

source_end.description: Exclusive upper bound on the source clock for this segment. Null opens the last segment above all finite source times.

scale.description: Multiplicative coefficient applied to a native source-clock value within this segment. Positive segment scales preserve increasing time.

offset_s.description: Additive coefficient in seconds applied after scale to express a source-clock value on the reference clock.

rmse_s.description: Root-mean-square residual in seconds for anchors assigned to this segment. Null when no segment summary was recorded; it reports fit evidence rather than acceptance.

uncertainty_s.description: Uncalibrated uncertainty bound in seconds on the reference clock, currently the largest recorded uncertainty among anchors determining the segment. Null means no contributing anchor recorded uncertainty, not zero.

uncertainty_semantics.description: Text declaring how uncertainty_s was derived. Required when the bound is present because this column could legitimately hold differently derived uncertainty quantities.

aligned_external_events.description: Optional regenerable cache of external-event intervals projected onto a transform's target clock. It is never the timing authority, no public refresh API currently populates it, and alignment does not require a row here.

aligned_external_event_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the cached projection, generated by the database.

external_event_id.description: Native external event whose time interval this cache projects without changing the event's stored native timestamps.

alignment_run_id.description: Stored source-to-reference transform from which this cached projection was derived.

target_timebase_id.description: Clock in which the cached aligned interval is expressed. It is expected to be the cited run's target reference clock.

start_time_aligned_s.description: Cached event start in seconds on the target clock, derived from the native start and stored coefficients rather than replacing the native value.

end_time_aligned_s.description: Cached event end in seconds on the target clock. Null for a point event; when present it cannot precede the aligned start.

uncertainty_s.description: Uncalibrated uncertainty bound in seconds inherited from the transform segment used for this cache. Null means no bound was recorded, not zero.

uncertainty_semantics.description: Text stating the semantics inherited by the cached uncertainty value. Null when uncertainty_s is absent.

tracking_streams.description: One tracking-specific extension of a logical external stream, declaring the upstream artifact's spatial frame, time basis, confidence availability, and sample-count summary. Dense tracker samples remain in the registered artifact; VAWLUME performs no video processing or pose estimation.

external_stream_id.description: Shared identity of the parent external stream that this row specializes as tracking. The parent supplies project, recording, timebase, source, and coverage facts.

coordinate_system_id.description: Declared spatial frame in which the upstream tracking coordinates are expressed. Compatibility depends on this frame's identity, not on matching dimensionality or unit text.

native_time_basis.description: Which native coordinate the tracking artifact carries: time, frame index, or both. VAWLUME preserves that upstream basis rather than inventing another one.

nominal_frame_rate_hz.description: Caller-declared nominal frame rate in hertz. Required for a frame-only artifact and otherwise null when no rate was supplied; VAWLUME does not estimate it from video.

has_confidence.description: Whether the upstream tracker emitted a pose or localization confidence value (1) or did not (0). This records availability, not confidence calibration or identity certainty.

declared_sample_count.description: Number of samples found in the upstream artifact at registration, as declared from that read. Null means no count was recorded; samples themselves are not stored here.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the tracking-stream registration. Never interpreted as sample data by VAWLUME.

tracking_series.description: One registered upstream trace identified by a native track label and bodypart label within a tracking stream. This is metadata about the artifact, not a stored position series, bodypart ontology, or claim about canonical animal identity.

tracking_series_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the registered trace metadata, generated by the database.

external_stream_id.description: Tracking stream whose artifact contains this trace.

native_track_id.description: Trajectory or individual label preserved verbatim from the upstream tracker. An animal-like label is not proof of which canonical entity the trajectory represents.

native_bodypart_label.description: Bodypart or landmark label preserved verbatim from the upstream tracker. VAWLUME imposes no universal bodypart vocabulary.

canonical_bodypart_role.description: Optional project-level normalized role for the native bodypart, added without replacing the native label. Null means no canonical role was declared.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about this registered trace. Never interpreted as tracking samples by VAWLUME.

tracking_identity_associations.description: One interval-scoped, provenance-bearing claim that an upstream native track may correspond to a canonical experimental entity. Rows preserve candidate, ambiguous, rejected, and explicitly unresolved evidence; overlapping claims are legal and no row is itself a resolved biological truth.

tracking_identity_association_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the interval-scoped identity-evidence claim, generated by the database.

external_stream_id.description: Tracking stream containing the native trajectory this identity claim concerns.

native_track_id.description: Upstream trajectory label the claim concerns. Identity is keyed to the track over time rather than to one bodypart trace.

entity_id.description: Candidate canonical entity named by the claim. Null only for an explicit unresolved statement, meaning identity was examined but no entity could be named.

start_time_native.description: Start of the claim's interval in the tracking stream's native time basis. This native coordinate is preserved and never rewritten by alignment.

end_time_native.description: End of the claim's interval in the tracking stream's native time basis; it cannot precede the start. Overlapping intervals remain separate evidence rather than being reconciled automatically.

assignment_state.description: Declared state of the identity claim, separating candidate, assigned, ambiguous, unresolved, and rejected evidence. Even assigned is a stored claim, not VAWLUME-verified ground truth.

evidence_kind.description: Free-text declaration of what kind of evidence supports this association. It is required so no identity claim is stored without a stated basis.

identity_value.description: Numeric identity evidence supplied by the upstream source, when it supplied one. Null means no numeric value was reported and is never replaced with an invented certainty.

identity_value_semantics.description: Free-text declaration of what identity_value means, such as a similarity, likelihood, or probability. Required whenever the number is present so unlike scales are not silently compared.

calibration_status.description: Source- or caller-declared calibration status of the identity value, when known. Null means calibration was not recorded; VAWLUME does not infer or perform calibration.

review_state.description: Declared review state of this identity claim, when one was supplied. Null means no review state was recorded, not that the claim was approved.

method.description: Free-text name of the upstream or manual method that produced the identity evidence, when supplied. VAWLUME does not execute an identity classifier here.

analysis_run_id.description: Analysis run that produced or contextualized this claim, when one is cited. Null means no analysis-run provenance was recorded.

source_file_id.description: Registered source file from which this identity evidence came, when file-backed. Null means no source file is cited.

mapping_profile_version_id.description: Configuration-profile version used to interpret this evidence, when one is cited. Null means no mapping-profile version was recorded.

source_locator.description: Location of the claim within its source, such as a row or interval locator, when retained.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about this identity-evidence claim. Never parsed as a confidence value or resolution decision.

acoustic_references.description: One registered claim that a point or interval in a recording's native audio clock contains a useful reference signal. It says where and what to measure; actual response measurements and aggregated estimates live in other tables.

acoustic_reference_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the registered acoustic-reference claim, generated by the database.

recording_id.description: Recording whose native audio interval contains the claimed reference signal.

recording_channel_id.description: Recording channel to which the reference claim is limited. Null means the declaration applies to every channel in the recording, not that the channel is unknown.

external_event_id.description: Imported external event from which this reference was registered, when one is cited as provenance. Null means no event link; a link does not turn the reference into an alignment anchor.

reference_key.description: Caller-supplied stable identifier for the reference, unique within the recording.

reference_type.description: Free-text category of the claimed reference signal. VAWLUME does not privilege a closed set of tone, noise, or hardware-specific types.

native_label.description: Label preserved from the source that identified the reference signal, when one was supplied. Null means no native label was recorded.

start_time_s.description: Start of the claimed reference in seconds on the recording's native audio clock. Registration preserves this coordinate and reads no samples.

end_time_s.description: End of the claimed reference in seconds on the recording's native audio clock. It may equal the start for a point-like reference and cannot precede it.

frequency_min_hz.description: Declared lower frequency bound in hertz for the claimed signal, when known. Null means no lower bound was declared; this is metadata, not an observed spectral measurement.

frequency_max_hz.description: Declared upper frequency bound in hertz for the claimed signal, when known. Null means no upper bound was declared; when both bounds exist this one cannot be lower.

source_file_id.description: Registered source file containing the reference declaration, when one is cited. Null means no source file provenance was recorded.

source_locator.description: Location of the declaration within its source, such as a row locator, when retained.

mapping_profile_version_id.description: External-stream mapping-profile version used to interpret the source declaration, when one is cited. Null means no profile version was recorded.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the acoustic-reference registration. Never interpreted as a measured response.

sequences.description: One modeled ordered collection of event references produced under an analysis run within a recording, optionally narrowed to an epoch or entity. Current workflows deliberately keep the regularized timeline as a MATLAB working artifact and therefore leave these modeled sequence rows unpopulated.

sequence_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the modeled sequence, generated by the database.

analysis_run_id.description: Analysis run that would produce and own this ordered event collection.

recording_id.description: Recording within which the sequence is scoped, when one is named. Null permits a sequence whose scope is established elsewhere.

epoch_id.description: Recording epoch to which the sequence is limited, when one is named. Null means no epoch restriction is recorded.

scope_entity_id.description: Experimental entity within which the sequence is interpreted, when entity-scoped. Null means no single entity scope is declared.

sequence_name.description: Human-readable name assigned to this modeled ordered collection.

event_set_kind.description: Which event representation supplies the members: detections, consensus events, external events, or an explicitly mixed collection.

source_extraction_run_id.description: Extraction run supplying members when the sequence is based on extractor-native detections. Null when no single extraction run is its source.

source_consensus_analysis_run_id.description: Analysis run supplying consensus-event members when the sequence is based on consensus output. Null when no consensus analysis is its source.

ordering_basis.description: Declared rule by which members are ordered, currently defaulting to start time. It states the basis rather than recomputing or validating the order.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the modeled sequence. Never parsed as member data by VAWLUME.

sequence_members.description: One ordinal member of a modeled sequence, referencing exactly one detection, consensus event, native external event, or cached aligned external event. Current workflows do not persist the regularized timeline into these rows.

sequence_member_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the sequence membership row, generated by the database.

sequence_id.description: Modeled sequence to which this referenced event belongs.

ordinal_position.description: One-based position of this event within the sequence, unique within that sequence.

detection_id.description: Extractor-native detection used as this member. Null when one of the other three event representations supplies the member.

consensus_event_id.description: Derived consensus event used as this member. Null when one of the other three event representations supplies the member.

external_event_id.description: Native external event used as this member. Null when one of the other three event representations supplies the member.

aligned_external_event_id.description: Optional cached aligned-external-event projection used as this member. Null when another representation supplies the member; the cache never becomes timing authority.

start_time_s.description: Sequence-coordinate start time in seconds stored for the member, when the modeled sequence supplies one. Null means no member start was recorded and never substitutes for the referenced event's native authority.

end_time_s.description: Sequence-coordinate end time in seconds stored for the member, when supplied. Null means no end was recorded; when both endpoints exist it cannot precede the start.

bouts.description: One modeled bout derived as an indexed interval over a sequence under an analysis run, with the derivation method recorded. Current workflows leave this modeled bout layer unpopulated rather than persisting regularized-timeline groups.

bout_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the modeled bout, generated by the database.

analysis_run_id.description: Analysis run whose method would derive and own this bout.

sequence_id.description: Modeled sequence whose ordered members the bout groups.

bout_index.description: One-based position of this bout within its sequence, unique for that sequence.

start_time_s.description: Derived bout start in seconds on the sequence's declared timing basis.

end_time_s.description: Derived bout end in seconds on the sequence's declared timing basis; it cannot precede the start.

derivation_method.description: Declared method or rule used to derive the bout boundaries and membership.

bout_members.description: Records that one sequence member belongs to one modeled bout and gives its within-bout order. These rows remain unpopulated while current workflows keep regularized event groupings in MATLAB only.

bout_id.description: Modeled bout to which the sequence member belongs.

sequence_member_id.description: Sequence membership included in the bout.

ordinal_within_bout.description: One-based position of this sequence member within the bout, unique within that bout.

metric_definitions.description: One registered semantic definition of a derived metric: its stable key, value representation, canonical unit, meaning, scope, and derivation family. The row declares vocabulary; measured values instantiate it in derived_measurements.

metric_definition_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the metric definition, generated by the database.

metric_key.description: Stable programmatic identifier for the metric, unique within the database.

value_type.description: Declared representation used by instances of the metric, separating real, integer, text, boolean, and JSON values.

canonical_unit.description: Canonical unit declared for comparable instances of the metric. Null means no canonical unit was recorded, not that every value is dimensionless.

definition.description: Semantic definition of what the metric measures or reports, which governs interpretation of its stored instances.

allowed_scope.description: Declared target scope or scopes on which this metric is meaningful, when the registry restricts it. Null means no scope text was recorded.

derivation_family.description: Declared family grouping metrics produced by a related derivation method, when one is assigned. Null means no family was recorded.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the metric definition. Never interpreted as a measured value.

derived_measurements.description: One typed value produced by an analysis run that instantiates a registered metric for exactly one target. The target columns make the measurement's subject explicit; an optional recording channel qualifies how a target-bound measurement was obtained.

derived_measurement_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the derived measurement, generated by the database.

analysis_run_id.description: Analysis run whose declared method and provenance produced this measurement.

metric_definition_id.description: Registered metric definition whose semantics, value representation, and canonical unit this row instantiates.

detection_id.description: Extractor-native detection this measurement is about, when detection-targeted. Null when another target column names the subject.

consensus_event_id.description: Derived consensus event this measurement is about, when consensus-targeted. Null when another target column names the subject.

external_event_id.description: Native external event this measurement is about, when external-event-targeted. Null when another target column names the subject.

acoustic_reference_id.description: Registered acoustic-reference interval whose observed response this measurement quantifies, when reference-targeted. Null when another target column names the subject.

recording_id.description: Recording as a whole that this measurement describes, when recording-targeted. Null when another target column names the subject.

recording_channel_id.description: Recording channel on which the target-bound measurement was taken, when channel qualification is meaningful. This is a qualifier, not a second target; null means no channel was recorded.

entity_id.description: Canonical experimental entity this measurement concerns, when entity-targeted. Null when another target column names the subject.

epoch_id.description: Recording epoch this measurement summarizes, when epoch-targeted. Null when another target column names the subject.

sequence_id.description: Modeled ordered sequence this measurement summarizes, when sequence-targeted. Null when another target column names the subject.

bout_id.description: Modeled bout this measurement summarizes, when bout-targeted. Null when another target column names the subject.

value_real.description: Real-number payload when this row stores a real-valued metric instance. Null for every other stored representation.

value_integer.description: Integer payload when this row stores an integer-valued metric instance. Null for every other stored representation.

value_text.description: Text payload when this row stores a text-valued metric instance. Null for every other stored representation.

value_boolean.description: Boolean payload encoded as 1 or 0 when this row stores a boolean-valued metric instance. Null for every other stored representation.

value_json.description: JSON text payload when this row stores a JSON-valued metric instance. Null for every other stored representation.

unit.description: Unit recorded for this particular measurement value. Null means no unit was recorded; interpretation remains governed by the metric definition rather than inferred from magnitude.

derivation_details_json.description: JSON method evidence needed to interpret and reproduce the derivation, such as method version, source interval, settings, sample facts, and QC flags. Null means no additional derivation details were stored.

channel_response_estimates.description: One uncalibrated aggregate of explicitly selected acoustic-reference response measurements for a recording channel, metric, reference family, and optional frequency band. It retains QC and method semantics and is evidence, not a gain correction or preferred-channel verdict.

channel_response_estimate_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for the aggregated response estimate, generated by the database.

analysis_run_id.description: Response/QC analysis run whose declared aggregation policy and provenance produced this estimate.

recording_id.description: Recording whose channel response this estimate summarizes. One response/QC run cannot span recordings.

recording_channel_id.description: Recording channel whose measured response is summarized. A trigger requires the channel to belong to the named recording.

metric_definition_id.description: Registered response metric whose defined semantics and canonical unit govern the aggregated value.

estimate_key.description: Stable identifier for this estimate within its response/QC analysis run.

reference_type.description: Acoustic-reference family aggregated by this row. Families remain separate rather than being blended into one opaque channel value.

aggregation_method.description: Declared aggregation operation used on the selected supporting measurements, currently median.

aggregation_version.description: Version of the aggregation implementation whose semantics produced this estimate.

frequency_min_hz.description: Lower frequency bound in hertz shared by this estimate's supporting references, when the response is band-scoped. Null means no lower band bound applies.

frequency_max_hz.description: Upper frequency bound in hertz shared by this estimate's supporting references, when band-scoped. Null means no upper bound applies; when both exist it cannot be lower.

qc_status.description: Categorical summary reporting whether evidence is sufficient, divergent, warning-bearing, not comparable, or free of those findings. It is QC evidence, not calibration or scientific acceptance.

value_real.description: Aggregated numeric response value under the declared metric and method. Null records an explicit estimate with insufficient usable evidence rather than inventing a value.

unit.description: Unit recorded for the aggregated value and inherited from compatible supporting measurements. Null when no aggregate value or unit is recorded.

details_json.description: JSON record of aggregation settings, source counts, descriptive summaries, divergence checks, and QC flags that state how this estimate was produced and assessed.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about the response estimate. Never parsed as a correction factor or caller score.

channel_response_estimate_sources.description: Records one exact derived measurement admitted as support for one channel-response estimate. This restrictive lineage makes the aggregate population inspectable and prevents supporting evidence from being deleted while the estimate survives.

channel_response_estimate_id.description: Channel-response estimate supported by the cited measurement.

derived_measurement_id.description: Exact acoustic-reference response measurement admitted into the estimate's support set; deletion is restricted while this citation remains.

attribution_runs.description: One attempt to attribute callers for a declared set of vocal events in one recording, preserving the analysis, method, settings, path, lifecycle state, and any parent attempt that make its results interpretable.

attribution_run_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for this attribution attempt, generated by the database and meaningful only inside this file.

analysis_run_id.description: Analysis-run provenance record that owns this attribution attempt and states the caller-supplied software identity under which it ran.

recording_id.description: Recording whose vocal events this attribution attempt considers. Targets, candidates, imported windows, and resolved entities are constrained to this recording's scope.

parent_attribution_run_id.description: Earlier attribution attempt from which this attempt descends, when the caller declares such lineage. Null means no parent attempt is recorded; a run cannot name itself.

run_key.description: Caller-supplied identifier for this attribution attempt, unique within its analysis run. Together with analysis_run_id it is the attempt's durable identity rather than a database-generated surrogate.

attribution_path.description: Declared route by which attribution is produced: imported external assertions, a backend, or a native estimate. The schema admits all three for version-stable storage, while the current public workflow reaches only the imported route.

method.description: Caller-declared method name for this attribution attempt. It identifies the approach but does not by itself claim validation, calibration, or a particular evidence combination.

settings_profile_version_id.description: Exact registered settings-profile version used by this attribution attempt, when one was recorded. Null means no linked settings version is available, not that default settings can be inferred.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the attribution attempt: planned, complete, or failed. The current public workflow marks it complete once every target has a decision and then freezes candidate and evidence writes, while still permitting a later policy decision over that frozen evidence; complete is not a scientific-validation claim.

failure_code.description: Machine-readable reason a failed attribution attempt did not complete. Required when status is failed and otherwise nullable.

created_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp recorded when VAWLUME created this attribution-run row. An audit time, not the time of any vocal event.

notes.description: Additional attribution-run context. Public writers may store structured provenance here, but the schema treats the value as text and readers must not infer unstated settings from it.

attribution_targets.description: One vocal event considered by an attribution run, identified as exactly one detection, consensus event, or agreement group. The three foreign-key alternatives are the discriminator, and a group target also declares which derived extent it means.

attribution_target_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for this run-scoped attribution target, generated by the database.

attribution_run_id.description: Attribution attempt whose target set contains this event. Public setup keeps one target kind within a run rather than mixing event populations with different denominators.

detection_id.description: Detection targeted by this row when the run operates on native extractor detections. Exactly one of detection_id, consensus_event_id, and agreement_group_id is present.

consensus_event_id.description: Pairwise consensus event targeted by this row when the run operates on that event set. Exactly one of the three target references is present.

agreement_group_id.description: Arbitrary-N agreement group targeted by this row when the run operates on composed event groups. Because a group has no intrinsic interval, agreement_extent_method is required with this reference.

agreement_extent_method.description: Declared rule used to derive the temporal extent of an agreement-group target, such as a union, intersection, mean, longest-member, or shortest-member boundary. Null for detection and consensus-event targets.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about why or how this event entered the attribution target set. Never parsed as candidate evidence or as a decision.

attribution_candidates.description: One experimental entity considered as a possible caller for one attribution target. A candidate records a possibility and its source values; it is neither an evidence observation nor the conclusion of a policy decision.

attribution_candidate_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for this target-and-entity candidate, generated by the database.

attribution_target_id.description: Vocal-event target for which this entity is a possible caller. The same target may deliberately have several candidates.

entity_id.description: Canonical experimental entity considered as the possible caller. A trigger requires the entity to be linked to the attribution run's recording.

candidate_status.description: Controlled state describing whether the entity is merely a candidate, selected, or rejected. This candidate-layer state does not replace the separate versioned decision record.

candidate_rank.description: Optional one-based presentation rank supplied for this candidate, ordinarily ordering a source score. It is not an independent judgment or a probability.

score.description: Optional numeric score supplied for this candidate on the scale stated by score_semantics. The range is intentionally unconstrained, and VAWLUME neither converts it to probability nor treats null as zero.

score_semantics.description: Declaration that makes score interpretable by naming what the number measures, its direction, scale, or source convention as applicable. Required whenever score is present.

probability.description: Optional value between zero and one asserted as a probability for this candidate under probability_semantics. It is not calibrated by VAWLUME and is never derived automatically from score.

probability_semantics.description: Declaration of whose probability claim is stored and what event or interpretation it concerns. Required whenever probability is present; it does not certify calibration.

source_label.description: Caller label supplied by the originating system or input when retained with the canonical entity candidate. Null means no source label was recorded, not that one can be reconstructed.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about this candidate. Never parsed as evidence, a score definition, or a decision.

attribution_evidence.description: One long-form evidence observation about an attribution target as a whole or one of its candidates. It keeps temporal, pose, identity, acoustic, correspondence, and imported composite evidence explicit without turning any observation into a conclusion.

attribution_evidence_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for this evidence observation, generated by the database.

attribution_target_id.description: Attribution target to which this evidence observation applies. Candidate-scoped evidence must name a candidate belonging to this same target.

attribution_candidate_id.description: Specific possible caller supported or described by this evidence, when the observation is candidate-scoped. Null makes the observation about the target as a whole rather than every candidate.

evidence_dimension.description: Closed high-level category that keeps temporal alignment, pose localization, visual identity, acoustic, correspondence, and imported composite evidence distinguishable. The categories do not imply that VAWLUME combines them.

evidence_kind.description: Source- or method-specific name for what was observed within the declared evidence dimension. It remains open text so an unfamiliar upstream measure need not be forced into a false standardized kind.

value_real.description: Optional numeric value observed for this evidence item under value_semantics. Null records the absence of a numeric value and never means zero, one, false, or certainty.

value_text.description: Optional textual value retained for evidence that is categorical, verbatim, or otherwise not faithfully represented by value_real. Its interpretation comes from the evidence kind and surrounding provenance.

value_units.description: Units explicitly recorded for value_real when the evidence source or mapping declares them. Null means no units were recorded; VAWLUME does not infer units from the evidence kind.

value_semantics.description: Declaration that makes value_real readable by stating what the numeric evidence means, including source scale or direction where applicable. Required whenever value_real is present.

identity_statement_kind.description: Declares whether identity evidence rests on a source-declared entity link or on a tracking identity association. When present, the corresponding external-event or tracking-association reference is required so the two statement types cannot be used silently.

tracking_identity_association_id.description: Tracking association cited when this observation uses reviewed or otherwise explicit track-to-entity identity evidence. This answers which identity-association statement was read, not which source event supplied a label.

external_event_id.description: External event cited when this observation uses a source-declared entity link. This preserves a declared label lookup separately from tracking identity evidence and does not turn it into visual identification.

alignment_run_id.description: Exact source-to-reference clock transform cited by this evidence observation when timing was aligned. This answers which temporal projection was used, independently of the event or file that supplied evidence.

source_file_id.description: Registered source file from which this evidence observation was read, when the evidence is file-backed. Deletion leaves the observation but clears this optional provenance link.

mapping_profile_version_id.description: Exact configuration-profile version that interpreted the evidence source, when one was registered. This records the mapping rules separately from the file and locator.

source_locator.description: Source-native locator for the exact record, row, key, or region that supplied this evidence when available. It is provenance text, not a foreign key or a computed score.

notes.description: Additional context about this evidence observation, including structured upstream detail when a writer preserves it there. Never parsed as an attribution decision.

attribution_decisions.description: One conclusion produced for an attribution target under one immutable policy-profile version. Decisions remain distinct from candidates and evidence, record the threshold actually applied, and permit later policies to reach additional conclusions without rewriting earlier ones.

attribution_decision_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for this policy-specific attribution conclusion, generated by the database.

attribution_target_id.description: Vocal-event target about which this decision was made. A target may retain decisions from different policy versions, but only one per exact policy version.

decision_status.description: Policy conclusion distinguishing one assigned caller, no assignment, unresolved ambiguity, simultaneous callers, or QC exclusion. Ambiguous means the policy could not choose; simultaneous means it concluded that multiple selected callers occurred.

policy_profile_version_id.description: Exact immutable policy-profile version that produced this conclusion. Required so the decision remains interpretable and comparable after policy rules change.

applied_threshold.description: Optional numeric threshold that actually bounded this decision under the cited policy. It is retained alongside the full policy version and is not claimed to be calibrated.

applied_threshold_semantics.description: Declaration identifying which policy quantity applied_threshold bounded and how to interpret the number. Required whenever an applied threshold is stored.

exclusion_reason.description: Reason the target was excluded by policy or QC. Required for an excluded decision and nullable for other outcomes.

decided_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp recorded when VAWLUME stored this policy conclusion. An audit time, not the time of the vocal event or its evidence.

notes.description: Free-text remarks about this policy conclusion. Never substitutes for the policy version, applied-threshold semantics, exclusion reason, or selected-candidate links.

attribution_decision_candidates.description: One selected candidate belonging to one attribution decision. The link represents a set rather than a single winner, allowing assigned decisions to select one candidate and simultaneous decisions to select multiple candidates while other statuses select none.

attribution_decision_id.description: Policy conclusion whose selected-candidate set contains this link. Insert and decision-status-update triggers check the permitted size of that set; direct SQL deletion is outside that public-write guarantee.

attribution_candidate_id.description: Candidate selected by the decision. A trigger requires it to belong to the same attribution target as the decision.

selection_role.description: Optional caller- or policy-supplied role describing how this candidate participates in a multi-candidate selection. Null means no additional role was recorded.

imported_attribution_windows.description: One vocalization window asserted by an external attribution system, preserved in that source's native clock before any correspondence to a VAWLUME event. The row is a statement about time; caller assertions are separate claim rows.

imported_attribution_window_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for this imported source window, generated by the database.

attribution_run_id.description: Imported-path attribution attempt that received this external window. The native window identifier is unique within this run when one is present.

recording_id.description: Recording to which the imported window was mapped. A trigger requires it to match the attribution run's recording.

timebase_id.description: Declared native clock on which start_time_native and end_time_native are expressed, when that clock is registered. Null means no linked timebase was stored and does not authorize inferring one.

native_window_id.description: Window identifier supplied by the exporting attribution system, preserved as source identity when available. It is unique within the attribution run but need not be globally meaningful.

start_time_native.description: Start coordinate exactly as mapped from the external system on the window's native clock. Its unit follows the declared source mapping; it is never overwritten by an aligned value.

end_time_native.description: End coordinate exactly as mapped from the external system on the window's native clock, constrained not to precede the start. Its unit follows the declared source mapping and is not inferred.

source_file_id.description: Registered source file from which this external window was imported. Deletion clears the optional link without erasing the imported assertion.

mapping_profile_version_id.description: Exact attribution-input mapping-profile version that interpreted this source window, when one was registered. It records the declared field and label rules applied at intake.

source_locator.description: Source-native locator for the exact external record that supplied this window, such as a row or key. Preserved for audit rather than interpreted as an event identity.

notes.description: Additional context retained with this imported window. Never parsed as a caller claim or used to replace a correspondence row.

imported_attribution_claims.description: One external system's assertion that a source caller label produced the vocalization in one imported window, with its original score or probability meaning preserved. An imported claim is not a VAWLUME candidate or decision and correspondence never promotes it implicitly.

imported_attribution_claim_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for this imported caller assertion, generated by the database.

imported_attribution_window_id.description: External vocalization window over which this caller assertion was made. One window may retain several distinct source-label claims.

claim_ordinal.description: One-based source order of this claim within its imported window. It preserves ordering without ranking the assertion by confidence.

source_caller_label.description: Caller token exactly as supplied by the exporting attribution system. It remains source text even when a declared mapping resolves the claim to a canonical entity.

entity_id.description: Canonical experimental entity to which the source label resolved under a declared mapping, when resolution was permitted and succeeded. Null honestly preserves an unresolved label under a future policy that allows one; the shipped declared-only policy currently refuses such imports instead.

score.description: Optional score asserted by the exporting attribution system on the scale stated by score_semantics. VAWLUME preserves it without constraining its range, converting it to probability, or treating null as zero.

score_semantics.description: Declared source meaning that makes the imported score interpretable, including its scale or direction as applicable. Required whenever score is present.

probability.description: Optional value between zero and one that the exporting system called a probability for this claim. It is preserved as that system's uncalibrated assertion and never inferred from a label or score.

probability_semantics.description: Declared source meaning of the imported probability, identifying the claim whose probability the exporter reported. Required whenever probability is present and does not certify calibration.

source_locator.description: Source-native locator for the exact record that supplied this caller claim, when available. It complements the parent window's locator without becoming evidence or identity itself.

notes.description: Additional context retained with this imported assertion. Never parsed as a VAWLUME candidate, decision, or calibration statement.

attribution_window_correspondences.description: One measured correspondence between an imported attribution window and one VAWLUME attribution target under a declared native or aligned interval basis. Multiple rows preserve competing matches; this table records correspondence evidence and does not choose a caller or assert equivalence.

attribution_window_correspondence_id.description: VAWLUME surrogate key for this imported-window-to-target correspondence, generated by the database.

imported_attribution_window_id.description: External attribution window being compared. Its native timing remains unchanged even when this correspondence stores an aligned projection.

attribution_target_id.description: VAWLUME detection, consensus event, or agreement-group target compared with the imported window. Several target rows may correspond to one window so ambiguity is retained rather than resolved here.

alignment_run_id.description: Exact clock-transform attempt used to project the imported window when iou_basis is aligned. Required for aligned comparisons and nullable for a native-clock comparison.

aligned_start_s.description: Imported window's projected start coordinate in reference-clock seconds when an alignment was evaluated. It is derived correspondence data and never replaces start_time_native.

aligned_end_s.description: Imported window's projected end coordinate in reference-clock seconds when an alignment was evaluated, constrained not to precede an aligned start when both exist.

temporal_overlap_s.description: Non-negative duration in seconds shared by the imported window and target under iou_basis, when overlap was computed. Null means no numeric overlap was recorded, not zero overlap.

temporal_iou.description: Temporal intersection-over-union between zero and one for this correspondence under iou_basis, when computed. It measures interval overlap and is neither caller probability nor calibration.

onset_difference_s.description: Signed difference in seconds between the compared window and target onsets under the declared comparison basis. Its sign follows the correspondence method rather than an inferred universal convention.
